title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SWITCH OFF SLEEP?

segments.line: You go up to the roof to think. Sunrise number seven.
Your little sister followed you. She saw the switch.
The man on the phone wants one too. For everyone.
A whole city that never sleeps.
Four extra months a year, for every person in the city.
Factories that never close. Schools that never end. Who'd say no?
Your sister tugs your sleeve. She just wants to stay up for cartoons.
You know what it costs. They don't.
So do you flip it back on, and lose it forever?
Or keep it, and find out what happens on day twelve?

shots.line: You go up to the roof to think. Sunrise number seven.
shots.note: the roof at sunrise, the sun low; you sit alone on the parapet, small against the city; DAY 7 tag

shots.line: Your little sister followed you. She saw the switch.
shots.note: the roof door opens left; your little sister steps out in pajamas, happy, and pads over to you
sis, happy, bouncing on her toes, points at you: she wants one

shots.line: The man on the phone wants one too. For everyone.
shots.note: the man in the suit by the parapet, phone at his ear, lowers it and smiles: for everyone

shots.line: A whole city that never sleeps.
shots.note: the whole city: every window snaps on at once, a city that never sleeps

shots.line: Four extra months a year, for every person in the city.
shots.note: the three of you on the roof, the city behind; windows switch on block by block

shots.line: Factories that never close. Schools that never end. Who'd say no?
shots.note: over the suit's shoulder onto the glowing city: tags pop OPEN 24/7, SCHOOL NEVER ENDS; he turns to you, hand out: who'd say no?

shots.line: Your sister tugs your sleeve. She just wants to stay up for cartoons.
shots.note: sis tugs your sleeve, happy; you look down at her

shots.line: You know what it costs. They don't.
shots.note: you, worried, eyes still glowing; the music drops away

shots.line: So do you flip it back on, and lose it forever?
shots.note: your hand over the switch, set to OFF, hesitating: flip it back on?

shots.line: Or keep it, and find out what happens on day twelve?
shots.note: you look into the sun; the string lights and the city die all at once; black, only your glowing eyes
end card on black: what would you do? FLIP IT BACK ON / KEEP IT, then THE END
